description: This file provides inline helper functions for managing PUCCH resource indices within a 3GPP-based wireless communication system, specifically for resource set configurations, SR, and CSI resources.

methods.name: get_pucch_res_set_0_cell_res_idx
methods.description: Calculates the index of a Resource Set 0 resource in the cell PUCCH resource list based on resource set configuration and resource index.

methods.name: get_pucch_res_set_1_cell_res_idx
methods.description: Calculates the index of a Resource Set 1 resource in the cell PUCCH resource list based on resource set configuration and resource index.

methods.name: get_pucch_sr_cell_res_idx
methods.description: Calculates the index of a PUCCH resource for SR in the cell PUCCH resource list.

methods.name: get_pucch_csi_cell_res_idx
methods.description: Calculates the index of a PUCCH resource for CSI in the cell PUCCH resource list.
